exercise.name: JM Press
library_steps: Lie on a flat bench, bar over your chest, hands just inside shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows and let the bar travel down towards your chin.
Press it back up along the same path, elbows tucked in.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying on a flat bench, a bar held close-grip; from straight arms the elbows bend ~130 deg and travel toward the feet so the bar comes down over the throat. Triceps does the most, chest and front delts help.

setup.target: Close: hands just inside shoulder width, palms down.
setup.why: Library step 1; LEHM and SAET21: a narrower grip raises triceps activity.

setup.target: Flat bench, back and head on the pad, feet on the floor.

movement.measure: angle from the trunk toward the feet

muscles.emg: Elbow extensor; overhead elbow extension grew the long head 1.5x more than at the side (MAEO).
Active in all bench-press grips; less with a narrow grip (LEHM).
Active in bench press at every grip width (SAET21).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms swing out to the sides.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Turns it into a wide press with less triceps.

sources.citation: Lehman GJ. 2005. The influence of grip width and forearm pronation/supination on upper-body myoelectric activity during the flat bench press. J Strength Cond Res.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench press holds: narrowing the grip raised triceps activity; a supinated (reverse) grip raised biceps and clavicular pectoralis activity.

sources.citation: Saeterbakken AH, Stien N, Pedersen H, et al. 2021. The effect of grip width on muscle strength and electromyographic activity in bench press among novice- and resistance-trained men. Int J Environ Res Public Health 18(12):6444.
sources.what_it_gave: 6-RM bench press: wide grip gave lower triceps activity than medium and narrow; anterior deltoid active at all widths; narrow grip used lower loads.

sources.citation: Tiwana MS, Sinkler MA, Bordoni B. 2023. Anatomy, Shoulder and Upper Limb, Triceps Muscle. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps brachii: three heads on the back of the upper arm, extends the elbow; the long head starts on the shoulder blade.

clip_check.check: Bar over the throat at the bottom
